name: Personal Ops
description: Daily journal, briefings, follow-ups. A personal command center. Recommended add-ons: a calendar MCP, an email MCP, and a daily-summary skill.

starter_tasks.details: Customize with the channels you care about (calendar, email, urgent threads). Schedule this task to run before your workday starts.
